character.description: compact bronze armored sentinel with shield and spear, south-facing combat animation

idle.action: solid armored breathing idle with shield and spear held fully inside the cell

walk.action: measured shield-forward four-step walk with planted contacts

run.action: faster committed armored run while shield and spear remain fully visible

attack_charge.action: brace shield, lower spear, and prepare a forward charge with feet planted

attack_execute.action: clear lance-and-shield charge follow-through with no detached effect or crop

recover.action: return from charge follow-through to ready shield stance

hit.action: brief heavy recoil while complete shield and spear stay visible

death.action: controlled armored collapse with no detached equipment
